newsitem.title: USA: Quality Dining sees growth from Bruegger's.
newsitem.headline: Quality Dining sees growth from Bruegger's.

text.p: Quality Dining Inc said Wednesday that its Bruegger's Corp unit, acquired in June, will enhance the company's growth opportunities.
"As the Bruegger's division grows, it should be the driving force on revenue and income generation for our company," Daniel Fitzpatrick, chairman, said in a statement.
Bruegger's is the largest fresh bagel chain in the U.S.
Quality Dining today reported third quarter earnings of $0.17 a share before restructuring and integration costs, down from $0.27 a year earlier.
After a pretax charge of $8.0 million from those costs, Quality Dining had a net loss of $0.23 a share for the quarter, ended August 4.

Revenues for the quarter rose 148 percent to $63.6 million from $25.6 million a year ago due to acquisitions and growth in other restaurant concepts. Year-to-date, revenues rose to $172.6 million from $77.9 million.
Quality Dining said it had 490 company-operated and franchised restaurants at the end of the third quarter, compared with 150 at the end of the second quarter.
